_source: CBP ruling N306161 (4 Oct 2019), affirmed by H306336 (11 Feb 2020): lithium-ion battery packs for mobile medical carts, Chinese cells, main and communications boards, wiring and housing, assembled in Mexico: CBP held China. In the cited-only pool (D862); excluded here, with the ruling that affirms it.

product.name: Battery pack for a mobile medical cart
product.description: A rectangular lithium-ion battery pack for a mobile medical cart: 48, 56 or 64 lithium-ion cells, a main board assembly that runs software and monitors the flow of power between the cells and the cart, a communications board, wiring, a wiring harness, fasteners and a plastic housing.

operations.name: Populate and program the main and communications boards
Weld the cells into strings and connect them to the main board
Fit the cells, boards and harness into the plastic housing, seal, charge and test the pack

economics.duty_rates_note: Illustrative placeholder, not a sourced rate.
